bonusFSM.source:
function () {
            var transitions = [
                new game.FSMTransition("showIntro", "transitionReels", "onStartButtonPressed"),
                new game.FSMTransition("transitionReels", "spinReels", "onTransitionReelsComplete"),
                new game.FSMTransition("spinReels", "stopReels", "onLogicResponse"),
                new game.FSMTransition("stopReels", "checkMaxWin", "onReelsStopped"),
                new game.FSMTransition("checkMaxWin", "showMaxWin", "onHasMaxWin"),
                new game.FSMTransition("showMaxWin", "showSummary", "onMaxWinComplete"),
                new game.FSMTransition("checkMaxWin", "checkForRetrigger", "onHasNoMaxWin"),
                new game.FSMTransition("checkForRetrigger", "checkWins", "onHasNoRetrigger"),
                new game.FSMTransition("checkForRetrigger", "showRetriggerPopup", "onHasRetrigger"),
                new game.FSMTransition("showRetriggerPopup", "checkWins", "onShowRetriggerComplete"),
                new game.FSMTransition("checkWins", "requestSpin", "onHasNoWins"),
                new game.FSMTransition("checkWins", "showSpaghetti", "onHasWins"),
                new game.FSMTransition("showSpaghetti", "showWins", "onSpaghettiComplete"),
                new game.FSMTransition("showWins", "showBigWin", "onHasBigWin"),
                new game.FSMTransition("showBigWin", "requestSpin", "onBigWinComplete"),
                new game.FSMTransition("showSpaghetti", "requestSpin", "onShowWinsComplete"),
                new game.FSMTransition("showWins", "requestSpin", "onShowWinsComplete"),
                new game.FSMTransition("requestSpin", "spinReels", "onHasMoreSpins"),
                new game.FSMTransition("requestSpin", "showSummary", "onHasNoMoreSpins"),
                new game.FSMTransition("showSummary", game.Subgame.BONUS_GAME_EXIT_STATE, "onSummaryComplete")
            ];
            this.initFSMFromTransitions(this._bonusGameFSM, transitions);
            this._bonusGameFSM.exitState = game.Subgame.BONUS_GAME_EXIT_STATE;
        }
